notation.d: effective depth, not overall beam depth

rules.qualification: Text permits cap need not be less than75mm; expose this allowance separately. Also2d either side of other potential flexural-yield sections.
rules.display_expression: Close links extend 2d. End pitch limit: max(75, min(d/4, 8 db, 100)) mm.

rules.qualification: Figure 4-4 middle-region sign appears inconsistent; written paragraph f says not exceeding d/2.
rules.display_expression: First beam link within50 mm of joint face; remaining-region pitch no more than d/2.

rules.expression: two-piece Ulink135deg endhooks pluscrosstie; tail_each=max(6*phi_link,65mm); phi_link>=8mm
rules.qualification: Engage peripheral bars; respect alternate90deg crosstie-end rules. Closedhoop andcrosstie shapes differ.

rules.expression: closedhoop135deg bothends; tail_each=max(6*phi_link,65mm); phi_link>=8mm; parallel_leg_pitch<=300mm; ordinary_vertical_pitch<=Bc/2
rules.qualification: Long sides need crossties / overlapping hoops and correct longitudinal bar engagement.
rules.display_expression: 135° closed-hoop ends; straight tails at least max(6φlink, 65 mm). Longitudinal-bar engagement and leg limits also apply.

rules.qualification: db_min is smallest column longitudinal bar. No 75 mm allowance printed for this rule.
rules.display_expression: lo = max(Dc, clear H/6, 450 mm). Confined pitch limit = min(Bc/4, 8 db,min, 100 mm).

rules.qualification: Core dimensions measured outside transverse steel; h <= 300 mm. Needs strengths, core geometry and arrangement; pitch alone does not establish adequate hoop area.
Certain stiffness / discontinued-member conditions require full height; joint shear may require more.
Fully stressed straight deformed bars in tension. No Fe550 row; no invented interpolation or automatic bar grade selection.
rules.display_expression: Ld = the verified Table4.3 coefficient × bar diameter; steel and concrete grades must be known.

rules.qualification: Hook inside confined core. Eq 4.4.2(b) inequality glyph looks struck in rendered PDF and extracts incorrectly; do not encode OCR direction; engineer review needed. Distinct from hoop 6phi/65 tail.
Requires grades, force condition, support faces and approved lap locations.
rules.display_expression: Check spliced steel area at a section against50%, together with permitted locations, development length and confinement.

rules.qualification: Only the bounded NBC205 residential template. Does not establish Basanti covers; do not apply by default.
rules.display_expression: The restricted NBC205 template uses40 mm column /25 mm beam cover; these are not automatically Basanti project values.

rules.qualification: No universal fabrication bend diameter verified from official Nepal PDFs. BIS IS2502:1963 preview fetch failed. SAIL bend/rebend test mandrels are material tests, not automatic fabrication radii.
